study_identification_part.si4_title: Normative modeling of brain morphometry in self-limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Quantify individual deviations from normative ranges of regional brain morphometry in children with SeLECTS and assess associations with clinical manifestations and cognition using sex-specific normative models trained on typically developing children.

rci1_dataset_name.reason: The paper explicitly states that the normative model was trained on data from the developing Chinese Color Nest Project (devCCNP).
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: The data for model training consists of two samples: the CKG sample and the PEK sample. Samples from the two different centers are both sourced from the developing Chinese Color Nest Project (devCCNP).

rci2_hc_n.reason: The paper states that the normative models were developed using data from a multisite sample of 457 healthy individuals from the devCCNP.
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: Using age and sex as covariates, normative models for each regional morphometric measure were developed utilizing data from a multisite sample of 457 healthy individuals (47.3% female; aged 3 to 18 years) from the devCCNP.

rci3_hc_age.reason: The paper provides mean, SD, and age range for the devCCNP sample. The mean age of 10.44 ± 3.11 years and range of 3 to 18 years are explicitly stated in the participants section. The normative modeling section confirms the age range of 3 to 18 years.
rci3_hc_age.supporting_text: This project enrolled typically developing school-age Chinese children and adolescents, and this study comprised 241 boys and 216 girls, aged 3 to 18 years, with a mean age of 10.44 ± 3.11 years. ... data from a multisite sample of 457 healthy individuals (47.3% female; aged 3 to 18 years) from the devCCNP.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Children with SeLECTS showed more infra‑normal subcortical volume deviations than controls; counts of abnormal regions correlated with disease duration, seizure frequency, and Raven’s score, while average deviations largely overlapped between groups.
